positive: The noun 'case(s)'/'situation(s)'/'scenarios'/'contexts'/'circumstances' and multilingual equivalents (情况/情况下, Fälle, casos, случаях, 경우), especially in phrases like 'in some cases', 'in such situations', 'in this case', 'under these circumstances'. It fires on that noun token and likely predicts a following 'when'/'where' clause. In math reasoning: 'In this case,' / 'case 1', 'both cases'.
negative: Weak and diffuse. Possibly participles like 'tagged', 'imagined', 'joined', 'selected', and 'FROM' / 'consider/assume' (рассматривать, предполага) tokens. Low-magnitude negatives.

positive: Interjections and O-initial tokens at the start of words or names: 'Oh', 'OH', 'ah', 'Oklahoma', 'Orlando', 'OM', 'OC'. Possibly the 'Oh' in a model's reasoning ('Oh wait', 'Oh, I see').
negative: Words about simplicity, completing, or correcting: 'simple/simplest/straightforward', 'flip/flipping', 'logic', 'commit', 'restoring/correcting/completing/addressing', 'reinforce'. Maybe 'simplify' in math text.

positive: Opening square brackets and bracket-prefixed tokens: '[', '[in', '[A', '[...]', '":[', HTML/markup closers like '">'. Also short prefixes like 'res', 'rem', 'dep', 'D' at the start of a word. Citation brackets [1] and JSON arrays in web text.
negative: Anaphoric or 'other/such' expressions: 'other' (друг, innych, อื่นๆ), 'such/like that' (เช่นนั้น, ดังกล่าว, 如此一来, 与此, 与之), 'this' (이것). Also 'entities/entity' tokens. Mostly fires in non-English text, so negatives on English are weak.

positive: Very noisy. Possibly chemistry or lab text (catalyst, chromatography 色谱, preparation 制备) and capitalized name or initial tokens ('Michael', 'D', 'O', 'Reg', 'La'), plus dash/asterisk list markers (' -', '*'). Predicts tokens like 'fill', 'racial', 'ader/ading'.
negative: Chinese lab/classroom terms (实验, 制备, 课堂, 精制, 胺), single letters 'b'/'p', 'para', 'del', bare digit '9', and 'click' (点击). Low confidence.

positive: 'First'/ordering words: 首先, 先在, 先用, 'erste', 'первая', 'first', 'dahulu'. Sentence-initial 'First,' in step-by-step math reasoning ('First, let's compute...'). Output promotes 'first do X' continuations and suppresses 'again'/'another'.
negative: 'Form'/'type'/'format' tokens: 'form', 'forma', 'Form', 形式, 'tipo', '.Type', 'format', '的形式'. Also counts of people/items (三个, 三名, 两个人) and code tokens like 'Python', 'zIndex', '-array'.

positive: Noisy. Sequencing or accomplishment verbs: 'accomplish(ed)', 'implements', 'impacted', 'subjected', 'resembled', 'vervolgens'/'selanjutnya' ('subsequently'), and first-person Chinese '我做', '那我就', '了我'.
negative: Chinese number characters (七, 八, 九, 千) and Chinese emotion/atmosphere words (情绪, 气氛, 恋), plus 'create', 'generate', 'Generic', 'health'. Also 'at least / or more' quantity phrases (至少, 及以上, 不少于) and 'earliest'.

positive: Concrete or social group nouns and descriptors: 'circle(s)', 'sphere(s)', 'former', 'independent', 'individuals', 'identity', 'dominant', 'wheels', 'spells', and surnames (Lewis, Reid, Levi). Its output suppresses 'object', so it may fire just before a noun that is not 'object'.
negative: Abstract philosophy words about objects or reality: 'objects' (objetos, oggetti, 事物), 'reality' (réalité, 现实中), 'stimuli', 'perception' (知觉), 'experiencing', 'possess/memiliki', 'Abstract', 'undefined'. Essays on perception or epistemology.

positive: Noisy. Tokens starting with 'p'/'pk'/'pi'/'psi'/'mask' in code or math, such as '(pi', 'psi', 'xi' (Greek letters in math notation), and Portuguese/Romance 'permane', 'acredit', 'aci'. Promotes 'app/application', 'fixed'.
negative: Movement and action nouns (movements, 动作), 'porch', 'pitcher', 'Prec', and 'according to' (据). Low magnitude.

positive: Weak positive. Optics or numeric words ('optical', 'refraction', 'wavelength', 'Numer', 'Dem') and 'Here'. Placeholder markers like 甲/乙.
negative: Strongly negative on 'remaining/remainder/leftover/rest' words in every language (剩下, 剩余, übrig, remaining, remainder, остат, 남은). In math word problems: 'the remaining apples', 'how many are left', 'remainder 3'. This should be the dominant, very clean signal.

positive: List-introducing words: 'include(s)', 'mainly include' (主要包括), 'as follows' (如下, ดังนี้, berikut, 다음과), 'what are the' (哪些, 有哪些), 'for example' (例如, เช่น), 'various', 'combinations', 'consists of' (terdiri). Fires right before an enumeration. It suppresses 'or', so it may push toward items joined by commas rather than 'or'.
negative: 'Another'/'yet'/'still' tokens (another, ещё, Yet, 還是, 同时又), plus 'relevant', 'notable/notably', 'the following' in Russian/Dutch/Japanese (следующие, volgende, 以下の), and 'each' (各).
